title: Igniter
description:
The Igniter is basically the block version of flint and steel, if powered by redstone it places fire in the air block in front of it. In Toggle Fire mode, if it becomes unpowered it puts out the flame in front of it.

In its GUI you can switch between 2 modes:

- Toggle Fire (default): Will ignite the block in front when powered and extinguish it when unpowered.

- Ignite: Will ignite the block in front when powered. The fire stays when unpowered.

The front faces the direction you were looking when you placed it.

properties.label: Redstone
properties.value: Toggle Fire reacts to a rising and a falling signal; Ignite only to a rising signal
